item.title: Governance by spork and one multisig admin
item.body:
Pillars can create and activate sporks without anyone holding a private key for it. One
multisig replaces the separate Bridge, Liquidity and Plasma admin keys and the bridge
guardians. Every later consensus change in Phase 1 depends on this epic (roadmap M0).

- Governance embedded contract scoped to sporks and a `networkAdmin`
- Multisig embedded contract for operations
- Audit of vote arithmetic and snapshots, and rehearsal votes on testnet with real Pillars
item.author: dev-ada
